title: RFC005 §30.2 StageDataMatrix
$comment: Closed envelope for the joint sampling matrix `stage_data_matrix_hash` names. RFC005 §30.2: the normative sampler draws from a closed joint (split, pyramid_level, task_kind, cohort) -> probability mass over lineage-root draws, applied BEFORE fragment/view/augmentation expansion. Every infeasible combination must be an explicit `0` and a missing cell is a schema error -- which is why the axis domains are declared here and the producer requires `cells` to be their exact Cartesian product. The schema fixes the SHAPE; the masses are an owner content decision and this document supplies none. Mass is carried in MICRO-units summing to exactly 1000000, integer because the deterministic CBOR profile this hash is computed under (`rfc8949-core-det-nfc-int-v0`) has no float in its data model, and because §30.2's 'row/column marginals musia presne reconcile' admits no tolerance argument.

stage_id.$comment: The RFC005 §12 stage this matrix is frozen for. Named, never inferred from a run class.

splits.$comment: Declared split axis domain. Exact membership in the RFC003 split set is checked by the producer.

task_kinds.$comment: Exact RFC003 task kinds. Membership in the closed enum is checked by the producer against `unflatten.dataset.gates.task_eligibility.TASK_KINDS`, not restated here; the pattern only rules out wildcards and loose names.

cohorts.$comment: The source/domain cohort axis. Free-form declared strings -- RFC005 §30.2 names no closed cohort enum, so the matrix declares its own domain and the producer holds `cells` to it.

cells.$comment: Exactly the full Cartesian product of the four declared axes, in any order. An infeasible combination is present with `mass_micro: 0`; omitting it is a schema error (§30.2), which is what makes 'missing cell' distinguishable from 'zero mass' at all.

mass_micro.$comment: Lineage-root draw mass in millionths, applied before fragment/view/augmentation expansion. `0` is legal and means explicitly infeasible.

declared_marginals.$comment: §30.2: row/column marginals must reconcile exactly with the stage profile. Per axis, a complete map from axis value to expected summed `mass_micro`. An axis may be omitted (nothing was declared for it); an axis that is present must be complete and exact -- a partial marginal would let an undeclared value drift unnoticed.
